Filed general: the Ramapo team tournament is named but has no date or record and no wiki hub, and the post calls the list 'a version of' the one played (same treatment as 7050's 'team tournament at Ramapo').
player_note: The post says: 'TJ Holman & I played a version of it that won us the Ramapo Team Toruney in Coruscant.' (posted 10 February 2000; no date given for the event, and the list is only 'a version of' the one played).
